selected.prompt: Localized lighter-weight refinement of the provided custom 礼林 lotus monogram. Preserve the same humanist Song-inspired stroke skeleton, shared stems, two clear 木, 礻 turn, low lotus petal curves and central petal-shaped negative opening. Reduce the thickness of the central Chinese strokes and broad bottom supporting curves by about 18 percent, keep optical balance; medium-light weight, not hairlines. Reduce the heart-shaped dot at upper left to 60 percent of its current size, centered at the same location; make it a restrained geometric heart-seed integrated as the 礻 dot, not a conspicuous love icon. Preserve the petal-derived wedge terminals and custom structural connections, no ordinary font substitution. Keep ample internal space and the open outward lower-right finish. Uniform opaque #36593E deep green on flat #F8F7F3 warm ivory, no shaded or textured surface, no gradient. ONE centered symbol, no labels, captions, brand wordmark or extra symbols. All changes local and restrained; do not add petals or enclosing outline.

Make a precise small refinement to the provided rounded 礼林 lotus corporate logo. Keep every existing letterform, petal, lower shared curve, twin 木, open rightward ending, spacing and overall geometry unchanged. Change ONLY the detached heart dot above the left 礻: reduce it to about 55 percent of its current width and height while keeping its center in the same position. The smaller heart-seed should feel like a restrained typographic dot, not a large love/charity sticker. Give that tiny shape a geometric lower diamond point and shallow upper notch, compatible with the existing rounded stroke language. Keep the warm humane modular geometry and medium optical weight. Uniform flat opaque forest green #36593E on uniform warm ivory #F8F7F3. No shadows, texture, gradient or changed stroke shading. ONE centered logo only, no brand name, captions, lettering or new symbols. Do not redesign the flower or change its number of petals.

Use case: logo-brand. ONE original future-facing Chinese CORPORATE SYMBOL for 礼林生态 / 禮林生態, LILIN ECO. Direction: OPEN DIGITAL JOINERY, very different from soft calligraphy and flower-badge logos. A low compact stepped geometry with THREE crisp ascending stroke rhythms and generous corner cuts. Derive the structure from 礼林: left 礻 gesture plus the shared turning hook; double 木 stems, crossing bars and diagonal branches are unmistakable yet fused into one custom art glyph, not two complete words. Build a LOTUS from three upward folded petal cuts cut INTO these SAME strokes, using gentle convex sides and decisive flat terminals so it reads like a lotus opening, not mountains or a roof. Shared upper/lower beams evoke software systems and engineering coordination with human warmth, no circuit-board ornaments. A small heart-seed counter in the left point expresses 善心; an actual shared beam expresses 善念; an open outward rising rightmost terminal expresses 善行. Medium-light optical weight, no big solid background, no maze, only a few large negative spaces, highly original silhouette and clear spacing. Chinese character identity and contemporary geometry, not LL Latin letters. Flat #36593E deep green on #F8F7F3 ivory. ONE centered symbol, generous margin, no words or labels, no separate generic lotus picture or enclosing flower frame, no clipart leaves, full traditional lattice, tiny decorative notches, gradient, shadow, 3D or mockup. Do not mimic any existing brand.
